items.title: 迪拜商会推进企业AI应用，面向14,000家企业的培训计划
items.title_en: Dubai Chamber discusses AI adoption and training programme targeting 14,000 companies
items.category: 会议介绍既有培训计划
items.summary: 迪拜商会第四次季度商业组织会议介绍Agentic AI应用及培训计划，帮助企业将AI应用于行政和运营流程。14,000家是培训覆盖目标，并非已完成培训或已成交采购。
items.summary_en: The Dubai Chamber's quarterly meeting highlighted Agentic AI training for 14,000 target companies, not completed training or signed procurement orders.
items.why_it_matters: 企业AI服务、数字化系统、运营自动化及B2B技术合作。

items.title: 阿联酋商会与南非讨论扩大贸易和投资合作
items.title_en: UAE Chambers discusses expanded trade and investment cooperation with South Africa
items.summary: 阿联酋工商会联合会与南非方面探讨贸易、投资与企业合作，重点研究商会合作机制及阿联酋—南非商业理事会。当前为合作磋商，并非已签署新投资项目。
items.summary_en: The Chambers and South African representatives discussed commercial cooperation mechanisms, not a newly signed investment contract.
items.why_it_matters: 非洲市场开发、跨境贸易、企业落地、供应链和品牌出海。
items.why_it_matters_en: The Chambers and South African representatives discussed commercial cooperation mechanisms, not a newly signed investment contract.

items.title: 迪拜批准四项社区与小企业发展项目
items.title_en: Dubai approves four community and small-business development projects
items.summary: 迪拜批准涉及退休人员、农业经营者、家庭与传统社区设施的四项项目，包括Dubai Harvest农业及零售空间、Umm Suqeim社区会所升级和渔民活动空间改善。未公布具体施工包与采购金额。
items.summary_en: Four projects include farming and small-business space, community facilities and fishermen's majlis upgrades. No specific construction award was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 社区设施改造、小型工程、农业配套、物业及运营服务。
items.why_it_matters_en: Four projects include farming and small-business space, community facilities and fishermen's majlis upgrades. No specific construction award was disclosed.
items.gci_opportunity: 社区设施改造、小型工程、农业配套、物业及运营服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Four projects include farming and small-business space, community facilities and fishermen's majlis upgrades. No specific construction award was disclosed.

items.title: 阿曼签署426份政府土地使用协议，拟投资超1.045亿里亚尔
items.title_en: Oman signs 426 government land-use agreements valued over OMR104.5 million
items.category: 政府土地使用协议签署
items.summary: 阿曼住房与城市规划部披露2026年4月至10月签署426份政府土地使用协议，计划投资超过1.045亿阿曼里亚尔，涉及农业、渔业、食品、工业及商业。该金额为期间协议投资，并非当日新增。
items.summary_en: The 426 land usufruct agreements cover April–October 2026 and planned investment, rather than new awards made on the report date.
items.why_it_matters: 工业园投资、食品加工、仓储、土地开发与企业落地服务。
items.why_it_matters_en: The 426 land usufruct agreements cover April–October 2026 and planned investment, rather than new awards made on the report date.
items.gci_opportunity: 工业园投资、食品加工、仓储、土地开发与企业落地服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: The 426 land usufruct agreements cover April–October 2026 and planned investment, rather than new awards made on the report date.

items.title: 马斯喀特推进2,247万里亚尔电力基础设施项目
items.title_en: Nama implements OMR22.47 million of Muscat power infrastructure projects
items.summary: Nama Electricity Distribution披露2026年在马斯喀特省实施的配电网开发与投资项目，计划预算约2,247万阿曼里亚尔，重点提升电网容量、可靠性及效率。部分项目处于实施阶段，不属于当日新授标。
items.summary_en: Nama is implementing projects under its 2026 Muscat distribution-grid investment plan, not announcing a new EPC award.
items.why_it_matters: 电力设备、变压器、电缆、配电系统、机电施工与维护。
items.why_it_matters_en: Nama is implementing projects under its 2026 Muscat distribution-grid investment plan, not announcing a new EPC award.

items.gci_opportunity_en: Nama is implementing projects under its 2026 Muscat distribution-grid investment plan, not announcing a new EPC award.

items.title: 阿曼Mazoon铜矿项目投资1.83亿里亚尔，预计2027年初投产
items.title_en: Mazoon Copper Project worth OMR183 million targets early-2027 operations
items.summary: Mazoon Copper项目建设接近完成，总投资约1.83亿阿曼里亚尔，预计2027年第一季度投产，目标年产约11.5万吨铜精矿。金额为项目总投资，并非本周新授标。
items.summary_en: The project is nearing completion and plans to produce approximately 115,000 tonnes of copper concentrate per year from Q1 2027.
items.why_it_matters: 工业设备、矿山运输、运营维护、工业劳务与矿业供应链。
items.why_it_matters_en: The project is nearing completion and plans to produce approximately 115,000 tonnes of copper concentrate per year from Q1 2027.

items.gci_opportunity_en: The project is nearing completion and plans to produce approximately 115,000 tonnes of copper concentrate per year from Q1 2027.

items.title: 阿曼迪巴多功能渔港签署运营管理协议
items.title_en: Oman signs operating agreement for Dibba multi-purpose fishing port
items.summary: 阿曼农业、渔业与水资源部与Musandam Global Investment Company签署Dibba多功能渔港为期10年的运营管理与维护协议，包括设施升级、渔业支持、海运物流和旅游服务。未披露新的工程授标金额。
items.summary_en: A ten-year agreement covers management, operation, maintenance and upgrades of the Dibba fishing port.
items.why_it_matters: 冷链、海运物流、港口设施、旅游与运营服务。
items.why_it_matters_en: A ten-year agreement covers management, operation, maintenance and upgrades of the Dibba fishing port.

items.gci_opportunity_en: A ten-year agreement covers management, operation, maintenance and upgrades of the Dibba fishing port.

items.title: 阿曼南东部省披露约3.6亿里亚尔项目发展规模
items.title_en: South Al Sharqiyah development projects total about OMR360 million
items.summary: 截至2026年10月，南东部省在实施及已实施的政府和私人发展项目累计规模约3.6亿阿曼里亚尔，包括Khor Al Bat'h发展、阿曼海事博物馆及旅游和公共设施。该数值并非本周新签约合同总额。
items.summary_en: Completed and ongoing projects reached an aggregate OMR360 million by October 2026. This is not new weekly investment.
items.why_it_matters: 旅游设施、港口配套、食品加工、建筑工程及公共设施运营。
